'''2009 2K Event Day 1 John DellAngelo DS Coruscant: Imperial Square''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John DellAngelo]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Imperial Square|SE-D-coruscantimperialsquare.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Clarendox
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
